add.issue.name: The epiq skill leaves workflow to the team's board and lane descriptions

edit.description.md: The skill prescribed a workflow (status moves, self-assign, goals for big work, human-input-needed parking, closing prompts) that clashes with teams that want another one, and with comment-only agents. Cut those rules; keep what goals and tags are.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: cut the prescriptive workflow rules from .claude/skills/epiq/SKILL.md (and the bundled skill-content.ts); goals, tags and the board/lane-descriptions rule stay. #622. Existing projects get it after the next release via epiq_skill_install force: true.
add.issue.comment.author: G09A5H189Z5RN8C3EEVS1B1HB9

add.issue.name: The GUI log stays blank or stale while connected repos' commit reads time out

edit.description.md:
The log publishes only when timeline and commits both reply; each board change abandons the pending pair. commits:get reads every connected clone in turn with `git log --shortstat` over its whole history; the window (notBefore) is applied in JS after. On sp-factory-graph (5 clones) two clones hit the 10 s git timeout, and timeouts are not cached, so every request costs 30 s+: blank after reload, never updates in live mode while autosync pulls.

Fix: pass notBefore to git as --since (each clone under 1 s); don't hold the log's events back on the commits reply.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: a windowed clone is walked without stats, filtered by commit date, and only in-window commits are diffed (--no-walk --stdin), in lib/commits/commit-timeline.ts. Factory board: 0.25 s instead of over 30 s, same commits. Not --since: it drops a rebased commit under an older one. #623. The log still waits on the commits reply; not changed here.
add.issue.comment.author: G09A5H189Z5RN8C3EEVS1B1HB9

add.issue.comment.md: Solution (follow-up): a scrub over a windowed clone narrows the walked shas by commit date, so it diffs only the scrubbed window's commits again. #624.
add.issue.comment.author: G09A5H189Z5RN8C3EEVS1B1HB9
